name: Fairmont Royal Pavilion
desc: Wake to the sound of waves on Barbados' Platinum Coast. At Fairmont Royal Pavilion, all 72 oceanfront rooms and suites offer uninterrupted sea views-no pathways, no roads, just the beach at your doorstep. Enjoy sunset yoga, beach dinners, and swimming with turtles. Families love our interconnecting rooms and villa. With lush gardens, warm Bajan hospitality, and barefoot elegance, it's where relaxation and meaningful…
